description: This record covers the Power dataset group on the India Data Portal, which republishes datasets that the Ministry of Power, India, provides to the public. The resources listed include Installed Capacity Statewise, Daily Power Generation from nuclear, thermal and hydro stations, Energy Requirement and Availability from the Central Electricity Authority, Daily Coal Stocks at thermal stations, Daily Power Outage reports, Inter-State Generating Station renewable energy generation, State Control renewable energy generation, Daily Renewable Energy Generation and Transmission Lines, each as CSV with explore, preview and download options. The metadata names the sector as energy and the source as the Ministry of Power, with the transmission lines dataset pointing to the CEA API. Coverage is India nationally. Access: free download from the portal under the Open Data Commons Attribution License stated on the page. Caveats: the page lists resources but not their date ranges or update dates. It suits Indian power system capacity, fuel stock and reliability studies, and relates to the CEA API record catalogued here.
